_about: DEMO DATA: a 2007 Yamaha V Star 650 cruiser (variant unknown) for local testing and screenshots (scripts/seed-demo.mjs --bike). The research in research/ is real, public research for the model (owner's manual, NHTSA, owner forums, parts retailers; values marked "verify" were not confirmed). Not anyone's real bike: no VIN, mileage or color yet, so it shows the "needs info" placeholders.

car.engine: 649cc air-cooled SOHC 70° V-twin, dual Mikuni BDS28 carbs
car.notes: Demo bike (real public research for this model, not anyone's bike). Variant unknown: Custom (XVS650, 19 in front wheel), Classic (XVS650A, 16 in fat front + floorboards) or Silverado (XVS650AT, Classic + bags/windshield). Same engine and drivetrain. VIN, mileage and color still needed.

todos.title: Hard to start after sitting all winter
todos.notes: Cranks fine but only runs on choke, dies at idle. Sat about five months with fuel in the tank.
